    SELECT *, LAG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, order_id) AS previous_amount
    FROM orders
)

FROM x

ordered = orders_df.sort_values(["customer_id", "order_date", "order_id"])
ordered["previous_amount"] = ordered.groupby("customer_id")["amount"].shift(1)
ordered["amount_delta"] = ordered["amount"] - ordered["previous_amount"]
display(ordered[["customer_id", "order_date", "order_id", "amount", "previous_amount", "amount_delta"]])
solutions.polars:

orders_df = pl.DataFrame(orders)
result = orders_df.sort("customer_id", "order_date", "order_id").with_columns(previous_amount=pl.col("amount").shift(1).over("customer_id"))
